Equivalent inertia of two machine groups
Swinging together (coherent): M = M₁ + M₂; not swinging together (two-machine system): Meq = M₁M₂/(M₁ + M₂)
Bus types
Slack: |V|, δ specified; PV (generator): P, |V|; PQ (load): P, Q
Ybus formation
Yii = Σ admittances connected to bus i; Yij = −yij
Load flow methods
Gauss–Seidel (simple, slow, linear); Newton–Raphson (quadratic, few iterations); Fast decoupled (fastest, approximate)
Swing equation

M d²δ/dt² = Pm − Pe; M = GH/(πf) MJ·s/elec rad (G in MVA); per unit: M = H/(πf); constant accelerating power: α = Pa/M, ω(t) = αt, δ(t) = δ0 + ½αt²; initial angle δ0 = sin−1(Pm/Pmax); critical clearing time (Pe = 0 during fault): tc = √[4H(δc − δ0)/(ωsPm)], δ in rad, ωs = 2πf
Equal area criterion
Adec > Aacc → stable; Adec = Aacc → critical (stability limit); Adec < Aacc → unstable
Critical clearing angle (Pe = 0 during fault)
cos δc = (π − 2δ0) sin δ0 − cos δ0
Stability improvement
Steady-state: reduce X (double circuit, series capacitors), raise V; Transient: fast clearing, auto-reclosing, single-pole switching, high inertia
Excitation system & AVR
DC exciter, AC brushless (rotating rectifiers), static (thyristor) excitation; AVR → controls V and Q
Load frequency control
Δfss = −ΔPD/(D + 1/R)
Jacobian size, Kron reduction & tap changers
NR (polar) Jacobian order = 2(N − 1) − N_PV; Kron: Y′ᵢⱼ = Yᵢⱼ − YᵢₖYₖⱼ/Yₖₖ; real off-nominal tap keeps Y_bus symmetric, a phase-shifting (complex) ratio makes it unsymmetric
Phase-shifting transformer in Ybus
Complex ratio a = V_P/V_S, leakage y_t on the secondary side: Y = [[y_t/|a|², −y_t/a*], [−y_t/a, y_t]] (unsymmetric if a is complex)

Lossless, |V| = 1, small angles: P_ij = (θ_i − θ_j)/X_ij; [P] = [B′][θ]

Ybus formation
Yii = Σ admittances connected to bus i; Yij = −yij
Load flow methods
Gauss–Seidel (simple, slow, linear); Newton–Raphson (quadratic, few iterations); Fast decoupled (fastest, approximate)
Swing equation

M d²δ/dt² = Pm − Pe; M = GH/(πf) MJ·s/elec rad (G in MVA); per unit: M = H/(πf); constant accelerating power: α = Pa/M, ω(t) = αt, δ(t) = δ0 + ½αt²; initial angle δ0 = sin−1(Pm/Pmax); critical clearing time (Pe = 0 during fault): tc = √[4H(δc − δ0)/(ωsPm)], δ in rad, ωs = 2πf
Equal area criterion
Adec > Aacc → stable; Adec = Aacc → critical (stability limit); Adec < Aacc → unstable
Critical clearing angle (Pe = 0 during fault)
cos δc = (π − 2δ0) sin δ0 − cos δ0
Coordination equation (with losses)
(dCi/dPi) × Li = λ; penalty factor Li = 1/(1 − ∂PL/∂Pi)
Load frequency control
Δfss = −ΔPD/(D + 1/R)
Jacobian size, Kron reduction & tap changers
NR (polar) Jacobian order = 2(N − 1) − N_PV; Kron: Y′ᵢⱼ = Yᵢⱼ − YᵢₖYₖⱼ/Yₖₖ; real off-nominal tap keeps Y_bus symmetric, a phase-shifting (complex) ratio makes it unsymmetric
Swing equation in degrees
M = GH/(180f) MJ·s/elec-deg; d²δ/dt² = (180f/GH)·P_a elec-deg/s²; mechanical angle = electrical/(P/2)
Power transfer ↗ from Transmission Line Parameters & Performance
P = (VsVr/X) sin δ; Pmax = VsVr/X; find δ: δ = sin−1(PX/VsVr)
Lead/lag maximum phase frequency ↗ from Control Systems
(s + z)/(s + p): maximum phase at ω_m = √(zp) (geometric mean of the corners); gain there = 10 log(p/z) dB above the low-frequency value
Short line ↗ from Transmission Line Parameters & Performance
Vs ≈ Vr + I(R cos φr + X sin φr); A = D = 1, B = Z, C = 0
Surge impedance & SIL ↗ from Transmission Line Parameters & Performance
Zc = √(L/C) ≈ 400 Ω (line), 40 Ω (cable); SIL = V²/Zc
